page.layout: One text column, with the page number top left and a running title top right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: legat.primo.Ex quo necessario sequitur,ut quod fuerit emolumenti etiam illa augeat. quemadmodum Celsus ait in L. scribit,33.D.ad Trebell.iniquum esse,ad fideicommissarium damnum pertinere, ad quem augmentum non pertinet. ac propterea, si bonitas & precium illius fundi creuisset,non he [?]redis,sed fideicommissariorum hoc emolumentum esse oportere.
main_text.head: Partitio.
main_text.p: Quem habentem fundum.)Enunciatio I. Non si fundum filio fruendum pater dedit,eum iccirco illi prælegasse intelligitur. L. certum est,13.& L.4.hoc tit. ubi Impp.scribunt,prædia data liberis fruenda,in peculio profectitio numerari:& peculia profectitia, post morte patris in hereditate dividenda ad cōmunionem revocanda esse.
Verbis precariis.) Seq.11.Fideicommissa precariis verbis relinquenda sunt.
In quartæ rationem.) Seq. 111.Rogatus portionem suam hereditariâ restitue-re, quartâ eius partê retinere poterit.

page.notes: Running title at top right is set in heavy decorative type and could not be read. "non he redís": the word after "non he" is unclear and given as [?]. Also "|" appears after "creuisset," in the scan and was treated as a stray mark. "intel ligitur" is printed with a word break and no hyphen, so it is written whole. The Seq. numerals are printed as shown (11, 111, 1111). The page ends with a line broken at "here-" and the continuation is on the next page.
